new_command_policy: after migration 5, every newly committed command receipt has exactly one command_receipt_results row committed in the same authoritative UnitOfWork
semantic NO_CHANGE also persists its exact response snapshot while creating no domain revision/lifecycle/audit evidence
response JSON is strict canonical UTF-8, versioned, bounded by foundation-runtime/bounds.json and SHA-256 bound
result-row validation/insertion failure rolls the receipt, domain mutation, lifecycle evidence and audit back together
verification: PRIMARY KEY(command_id) supplies exact leading-prefix coverage for its command_receipts foreign key without redundant index
UPDATE and DELETE probes are rejected by exact append-only triggers inside rolled-back verification transactions
upgrade from accepted sequence 4 preserves command_receipts row count and content
clean initialization and 1..4 upgrade both reach the same exact release schema after sequence 5
